description: This file defines webhook target registration, resolution, and request handling functions for a plugin SDK, including route registration, target management, and request pipeline control.

classes.name: RegisteredWebhookTarget
classes.description: Represents a registered webhook target with an unregister method.

classes.name: RegisterWebhookTargetOptions
classes.description: Options for registering a webhook target, including callbacks for first target addition and last target removal.

classes.name: WebhookTargetMatchResult
classes.description: Result type for webhook target resolution, indicating none, single, or ambiguous matches.

methods.name: registerWebhookTargetWithPluginRoute
methods.description: Registers a webhook target and lazily installs the plugin HTTP route on first use.

methods.name: registerWebhookTarget
methods.description: Adds a normalized target to a path bucket and manages route state cleanup when the last target leaves.

methods.name: resolveWebhookTargets
methods.description: Resolves all registered webhook targets for an incoming request path.

methods.name: withResolvedWebhookRequestPipeline
methods.description: Runs webhook guards and dispatches the request if the path resolves to live targets.

methods.name: resolveSingleWebhookTarget
methods.description: Matches exactly one synchronous target or reports if resolution is empty or ambiguous.

methods.name: resolveSingleWebhookTargetAsync
methods.description: Async version of single-target resolution for I/O-based auth checks.

methods.name: resolveWebhookTargetWithAuthOrReject
methods.description: Resolves an authorized target and rejects if unauthorized or ambiguous.

methods.name: resolveWebhookTargetWithAuthOrRejectSync
methods.description: Synchronous variant of webhook auth resolution for in-memory checks.

methods.name: rejectNonPostWebhookRequest
methods.description: Rejects non-POST webhook requests with 405 Method Not Allowed.
